phase: P1 fixed-QRF full-distribution versus two-tail recalibration
forest_policy: load original seed0 leaf10 500-tree model; no fit, no tree/split/leaf-response changes; verify model SHA256 before and after
availability: identical P0 eligible/scorable dates; complete valid day with target_end <= origin; retain missing dates in bootstrap calendar; no current or future labels
PIT: weighted right-continuous full leaf-response ECDF with inverse-leaf-size tree weights; randomized distributional transform F(y-)+U*(F(y)-F(y-)); U seeded 20261107+year*100+farm, fixed once for calibration samples; invert empirical calibration-PIT law through current full ECDF; PIT exactly 0/1 mapped to physical bounds 0/1; adaptation inspired by regression CDF recalibration, not exact SCDRF/CPS and no finite-sample time-series coverage claim
DualTail: lower score q(alpha/2)-y; upper score y-q(1-alpha/2); each uses ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha/2)) order statistic; signed corrections allowed; crossed interval collapses to original raw midpoint; clip [0,1]
states: mutually exclusive issue-time states: raw ECDF P(Y<=.01)>=.5; else raw q50 hourly rise >.1 (h1 vs last observed); else other. Never uses future true power or ramp label
state_shrinkage: local calibration = same state and same six-hour lead band among arrived days; require >=20 distinct days and >=40 cells; otherwise global per-lead fallback. lambda=min(.8,local_days/(local_days+20)); mix local and per-lead global empirical laws. DualTail state uses same mixture and global finite rank/n threshold; heuristic conditional correction, no exact guarantee
evaluation: P0 matching 80/90/95 intervals; true-label regime, lead, power, month/season groups; method-specific median for WIS; original frozen median also reported as a common-median WIS sensitivity; full-ECDF arms get exact empirical CRPS; do not invent CRPS for interval-only CQR/DualTail
gate_policy: against CQR_signed84 separately per dataset/stage; report all components/arms, including failures; development gate on 2014 validation only; no new tuning on either evaluation period; retrospective evaluation cannot establish fresh confirmation
inference: synchronous circular 14-calendar-day paired blocks, 1000 draws seed20261107, full P0 evaluation calendars; 90% IS,width,coverage by all/up_ramp/near_zero; descriptive and conditional on fixed forests, no multiplicity correction
historical_status: all dates previously inspected; no fresh holdout, no novel algorithm or deployment-validity claim
scope_deviation: Jonkers2024 Algorithm3 SCDRF requires fitting a residual-target forest; excluded to honor fixed existing QRF. This phase tests a full-ECDF PIT recalibration adaptation and DualTail controls instead.
